# PaOS Terminal glyph data — SIL OFL 1.1

The two `Uni2-Terminus*.psf.gz` files are unmodified Ubuntu console-setup-linux
1.226ubuntu1 Terminus Font PSFs. `Terminus.NOTICE` is the verbatim complete
Terminus section of that source package's `copyright.fonts`, including the
copyright, Reserved Font Name and full SIL Open Font License 1.1.

Copyright (c) 2010 Dimitar Toshkov Zhekov, with Reserved Font Name "Terminus Font".
The modified combined table and the Unifont subset are named `vt_font` and
`vt-unifont`, respectively; the modified table is not named Terminus Font.

`vt-unifont.hex` contains verbatim selected lines of GNU Unifont 15.1.01,
Copyright 1998-? Jungshik Shin, 1998-2014 Roman Czyborra, 2004-2013 Qianqian Fang,
2005 Luis Alejandro Gonzalez Miranda, 2007-2019 Paul Hardy, 2013-2014 Andrew Miller,
2017-2019 David Corbett, 2018 Johnnie Weaver. These contributor notices are
retained from the source-package inventory and repository's canonical notices.
`Unifont.COPYING` and `OFL-1.1.txt` are verbatim from upstream 15.1.01.
PaOS elects the SIL OFL 1.1 option for these glyphs and their modified subset.
No GPL non-font Unifont tools or GFDL documentation are included here.

The fixed `coverage.json` and generated `src/gui/vt/vt_font.inc` are OFL-1.1
font data/mappings. Preserve these notices and the full OFL texts with copies.
The PaOS-authored Python converter/tests are Apache-2.0, per their SPDX headers;
they contain no upstream Unifont program code. Procedural block/braille geometry
is retained from the PaOS converter. All delivered glyph data remains OFL-1.1.
